spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (लोलति)
1 To stir or agitate, to make tremulous.
2 To be attached to or connected with, to join.

m. (-पः)
A buffalo.
E.
लुल to agitate, aff. क, stirring, shaking, (in the mud,) आप् to get or obtain, aff. अच्; it is also read लुलाय.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaken, trembling, tremulous, agitated, stirred.
2 Heaving, panting.
3 Agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, elegant.
4 Injured, destroyed.
E.
लुल to agitate, aff. क्त.
